assessment: This study examines the influence of voltage on conformational dynamics of voltage-sensing Hv1 channel at a single molecule resolution. Previously it was shown that although Hv1 channels lack a separate pore domain unlike most members of the voltage-gated channel family, the pore opening and voltage-sensing are distinct but linked processes. This study provides new insight in the mechanism of gating by showing that the voltage-sensor is able to access an intermediate conformation distinct from the activated and resting state.
